symbols.scope: Exact local Laurent stencils agree with the staggered continuum tensor symbols throughout the Brillouin zone. Reduction uses the noncanonical kinetic form. Checks include the zone corners, where centered derivatives would have unwanted zeros.

full_lattices.scope: Independent dense real-space reductions of complete periodic lattices. Positivity, all physical frequencies, null directions and local current brackets are checked without using individual Fourier blocks to construct the reduced matrices.

continuum_and_brackets.scope: The lattice wave has an explicit second-order dispersion error bound. The inverse kinetic form scales as momentum^(-3), so prepotentials cannot be assigned independent local canonical brackets.

metric_response.scope: Independent inversion of the complete first-order reduced kernel reconstructs the canonical metric response J/(omega_E^2+J g k^2) for both polarizations. This is the Gaussian quantization of the supplied action, not a pole derived from the microscopic spin measure.

scope: A supplied local staggered prepotential action has exact gauge null directions, positive physical energy and precisely two canonical tensor modes per nonzero lattice momentum, with the linear-gravity dispersion and the correctly reduced kinetic brackets. The inverse prepotential bracket is nonlocal, while specified gauge-invariant current brackets are local. This is a classical linearized-gravity benchmark adapted from the established prepotential formulation, not a microscopic finite-spin realization, nonlinear Einstein gravity, or TOE. Homogeneous Einstein data, physical state selection, matter coupling and microscopic quantization remain open. No Lean theorem.
